title: DI-28-01: Phase 1 call-chain extension for REST EP sink attribution (path_reachability fix)

dependencies.reason: change_manifest_session_28.json status=COMPLETED required. DI-27-01 root cause confirmed (Phase 1 shallow extraction). S5 complete for cartflows+pretty-link.

critical_notes: E1: source_ref wins over spec if they conflict. E4: PHP null discipline. E5: no scope expansion.
DI-28-01 is a MEDIUM-complexity fix — do NOT rush. Prototype on single REST EP first before implementing fully.

ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED: Phase 1 PHP extractor captures sinks only from direct callback body. REST EP callbacks are thin dispatchers — they call business logic 1-2 hops down. Downstream sinks are not attributed to the EP. Gate _check_path_reachable() therefore finds no sink match and returns 0.25.

Fix approach: in IRBuilder.php or EntryPointVisitor.php, when processing a REST EP callback, follow 1-hop method calls from within the callback body. Extract sinks from those downstream methods and attribute them to the same entry_point_id.
Scope constraint: 1 hop only (caller → callee). Do NOT implement multi-hop or recursive resolution — too complex, too much risk. 1 hop covers the thin-dispatcher pattern.
After fix: rerun Phase 1 for backwpup ONLY. Then rerun Phase 3 gate for backwpup. Then rerun benchmark. Do NOT rerun cartflows/pretty-link unless the fix logic affects their EP types.
Success gate: at least 1 backwpup REST EP finding moves path_reachable from 0.25 to >= 0.55 after fix.
IMPORTANT: read the PHP extractor code CAREFULLY before touching it. Understand how IRBuilder.php processes callback bodies and emits sinks. Don't guess.

DI-28-01.change: Extend the REST EP sink extraction to follow 1-hop method calls from within the direct callback body. When the callback body contains a method call (e.g., $this->process($request)), visit the body of that called method and extract sinks, attributing them to the same entry_point_id. Scope: REST EP type only (type='rest_route'). 1 hop only — do not recurse.
DI-28-01.note: Source_ref wins. If IRBuilder.php or EntryPointVisitor.php structure has changed, adapt accordingly. Do NOT assume function signatures — read the file first.
